svg.aria-label: prompt-cache-kit: Cheaper agent runs, same prefix every time. Agent briefs share one byte-stable outline, so the prompt cache hits. Steps: Build, a fingerprinted outline, locally; Brief, outline first, task last; Fan out, forks, subagents, workflows; Stats, hit rate per agent, cold ones named. Output: one total hit rate, and which agents missed.
